regions.name: Middle Gangetic Plains

regions.name: Central India (MP & Chhattisgarh)

regions.name: Maharashtra Interior & Vidarbha
regions.climate_risk: Rainshadow drought, unseasonal hailstorms, pre-monsoon squalls

regions.name: Konkan & Goa Coastal Strip

regions.name: Telangana & Coastal Andhra
regions.climate_risk: Post-monsoon cyclone landfalls, coastal storm surges, heatwave pockets

regions.name: Karnataka Interior
regions.climate_risk: Orographic rainshadow gradient, microburst convective showers

regions.name: Kerala Coast & High Ranges
regions.climate_risk: Monsoon onset vortex, intense orographic cloud bursts, landslides
